newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Baan Vendex on path to AEX index.
newsitem.headline: Baan Vendex on path to AEX index.

text.p: Computer software firm Baan and retailer Vendex are both on track to be included in the AEX index of 25 Dutch blue chip shares from next February, the Amsterdam stock exchange said on Tuesday.
The exchange said an interim calculation showed that Baan and Vendex looked likely to replace shipping group Nedlloyd and biochemicals group Gist-Brocades.
The composition of the index is revised each year in February to include the top 25 most actively traded shares.

The exchange said that on the basis of figures for 1995, 1996 and the first seven months of 1997 Baan and Vendex would qualify. Semi-conductor equipment maker ASM Lithography might also qualify for inclusion in the AEX, it added.

The interim turnover figures for the two years and seven months to the end of July showed that Royal Dutch Petroleum was the most heavily traded share in Amsterdam with total turnover of 175.4 billion guilders.
Runner-up was Philips Electronics (145.2 billion guilders), followed by financial group ING (110.1 billion), consumer products giant Unilever (106.5 billion) and bank ABN AMRO (96.8 billion).
